prompt: Sort employees by department ascending, then salary descending, then name ascending. Complete the sort method with a chained Comparator.
explanation: Comparator.comparing builds a comparator from a key-extractor method reference, and thenComparing chains tie-breakers that only run when the earlier keys are equal. To flip just one level of the chain, reverse that inner comparator (comparingInt(Employee::salary).reversed()) rather than the whole chain. Records generate the accessor methods (dept(), name(), salary()) that the method references use.
hints: Start with Comparator.comparing(Employee::dept) and chain the other keys with thenComparing.
To make one level descending, pass an already-reversed comparator: Comparator.comparingInt(Employee::salary).reversed().
Calling .reversed() at the very end would flip ALL levels -- reverse only the salary comparator before chaining it.
